description:
We’re NovaCore, a team bringing together game design, web development, and space science for NASA Space Apps Cairo 2026.

Our project, AstroBase Commander, is a proposed browser-based strategy game where players manage a Moon or Mars outpost. They’ll balance oxygen, power, food, and radiation protection and see how a decision in one system affects the rest. We plan to build a prototype with React and TypeScript and use NASA resources to inform the scenarios.

If you enjoy building.
